1. (Currently amended) A control system comprising: a controller having a processor and memory, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to automation components in the control system and to facilitate performance of a process through interoperation with the automation components by generating a holistic state data, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: determining a model configured to describe the process used by the controller; determining input and output variables of the process; determining constraints on the input and output variables; determining an objective function associated with the process used by the controller; and storing the model, the input and output variables, the constraints, and the objective function in one of a plurality of fields in the holistic state data to enable the automation components to detect and operate with the controller upon receiving the holistic state data, wherein the holistic state data comprises a standardized data structure that is machine-readable and configured to be parsed by the automation components to automatically configure interoperation with the controller.

2. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a communication network and to communicate the holistic state data to each of the automation components upon connecting to the communication network, wherein the holistic state data enables automatic discovery and configuration of the automation components without manual intervention.

3. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a backplane and to communicate the holistic state data to the automation components upon connecting to the backplane, wherein the holistic state data enables automatic discovery and configuration of the automation components without manual intervention.

4. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data is a standardized format understood by each of the automation components, wherein the standardized format comprises predefined fields that specify the model, input and output variables, constraints, and objective function in a machine-readable structure.

5. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: determining an intermediate search result of an optimization search; determining a state of the optimization search when the intermediate search result is determined; and storing the intermediate search result and the state in an optimization state field of the holistic state data, wherein the optimization state field enables the automation components to continue or resume the optimization search based on the stored state.

6. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data to facilitate performing an optimization search in conjunction with one or more of the automation components in the control system, wherein the holistic state data provides the automation components with sufficient information to participate in solving the optimization problem defined by the model, variables, constraints, and objective function.

7. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: determining computational capabilities of the controller; determining interconnections with the automation components in the control system; and storing the computational capabilities and the interconnections in a controller settings field of the holistic state data, wherein the controller settings field enables the automation components to determine how to allocate tasks based on the computational capabilities and interconnections.

8. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to communicate the holistic state data to a server in the control system to facilitate determining an optimization problem, wherein the server uses the holistic state data to formulate or refine the optimization problem based on the model, variables, constraints, and objective function provided by the controller.

9. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller comprises an in-memory database configured to store the holistic state data, wherein the in-memory database enables rapid access and retrieval of the holistic state data by the controller and the automation components.

10. (Currently amended) A tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium configured to store instructions executable by a processor of a controller, wherein the instructions comprise instructions to: receive, using the processor, control system configuration data comprising holistic state data from one or more automation components; determine, using the processor, automation components communicatively coupled to the controller and characteristics of the automation components based at least in part on parsing the holistic state data in the control system configuration data; determine, using the processor, an optimization problem based at least in part on the automation components and the characteristics of each of the automation components extracted from the holistic state data; and instruct, using the processor, one or more of the automation components to perform a control action in a process, wherein the control action is determined based at least in part on solving the optimization problem.

11. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a model used by the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on the model used by each of the automation components as specified in the holistic state data.

12. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a computing capability of the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on computing compatibilities of each of the automation components as specified in the holistic state data.

13. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the control system configuration data comprises a plurality of holistic state data, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data corresponds with one of the automation components and is received from the respective automation component.

14. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein the instructions to determine the automation components and characteristics of the automation components comprise instructions to parse each of the plurality of holistic state data to extract the model, input and output variables, constraints, and objective function from each holistic state data.

15. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data comprises a standardized format with same fields, wherein the standardized format enables the controller to uniformly parse and interpret the holistic state data from different automation components.

16. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the instructions to receive the configuration data comprise instructions to receive the configuration data from a cloud-based server, wherein the cloud-based server stores and provides the holistic state data from multiple automation components.

17. (Currently amended) A method for performing diagnostics on a control system comprising: determining, using a processor, holistic state data captured by a controller in the control system, wherein the holistic state data comprises a model, input and output variables, constraints, and an objective function; simulating, using the processor, operation of the controller based at least in part on the holistic state data while the controller performs other operations, wherein the simulation uses the model and objective function from the holistic state data to predict controller behavior; analyzing, using the processor, the simulation of the controller to perform diagnostics on the controller by comparing simulated results with actual results; adjusting, using the processor, operation of the control system based at least in part on the diagnostics.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17, wherein: simulating operation comprises simulating performance of various control actions by the controller; and analyzing the simulation comprises analyzing results of the various control actions.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein analyzing the simulation comprises: determining a predicted response to a control action determined by the controller using the model from the holistic state data; and comparing the predicted result with an actual response to the control action to determine accuracy of the model.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, comprising adjusting the model in the holistic state data when the predicted response and the actual response vary, wherein the adjusted model is stored for use in subsequent control operations.
